headline: Ivey signs Alabama vaccine mandate ban bills into law
snippet: Requires parental consent for minor COVID vaccines, bans vaccine passports.

headline: Alabama Legislators Pass Vaccine Mandate Exemptions at Close of Special Session
snippet: Passed with Republicans cloturing debate over Democratic objections.

headline: Business Council of Alabama: Anti-vaccine mandate bills put jobs at risk
snippet: State's largest business lobby warned bills could jeopardize Alabama jobs.
